items.title: Memory as Belief: Bayesian Evolution of Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
items.snippet: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. This paper proposes BEAM (Bayesian-style Evolutionary Agentic Memory), a framework that reformulates memory value evaluation as a context-conditioned dynamic belief. Experiments across reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that BEAM consistently improves memory utilization and enables continual self-evolution of LLM agents.
related_to: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory

items.title: Large language model classifies prior evidence in gene-phenotype associations
items.snippet: We present PESTO (Prior Evidence Status from Text and Ontologies), a source-grounded framework that combines large language model-based literature curation with structured genetic evidence to classify gene-phenotype associations. Applied to 940 significant associations, PESTO classified 7% as Novel and 21% as Hypothesized. PESTO thus provides an interpretable framework for assessing novelty and prioritizing genetic findings for follow-up.

items.title: Can a large language model flavour-tag a jet?
items.snippet: This paper investigates the capability of large language models to perform flavour-tagging on jets. The research explores the application of LLMs in a novel domain, assessing their ability to extract and interpret complex features from jet data. This work contributes to understanding the broader applicability of LLMs beyond traditional text-based tasks.

items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent: The agent that grows with you
items.snippet: Hermes Agent is an open-source autonomous AI agent built by Nous Research. It's designed for long-term, personalized AI collaboration: it learns your habits, adapts to your workflow, and supports ongoing tasks instead of one-off questions. This agent features a built-in learning loop that allows it to create new skills from experience and maintain persistent memory across sessions.

items.title: openclaw/openclaw: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way.
items.snippet: OpenClaw is an open-source AI automation framework designed for developers to have full control over their AI workflows. It runs on your infrastructure, provides complete source code access, and allows customization through TypeScript plugins and configuration. OpenClaw takes real actions in the real world, such as clearing your inbox and managing your calendar.

items.title: n8n-io/n8n: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities.
items.snippet: n8n is a workflow automation platform that combines AI capabilities with business process automation, offering technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code. It allows users to build modular AI systems that are easy to debug, explainable by design, and maintainable. The platform supports creating complex AI agents with explicit logic to stay in control of inputs and outcomes, blending 500+ integrations, AI agents, human approvals, and code into flexible workflows.

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence.
items.snippet: Firecrawl is a developer-first API that turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data for AI apps, agents, and research workflows. It offers industry-leading reliability, covering 96% of the web including JS-heavy pages, and provides blazingly fast LLM-ready output. The platform intelligently waits for content to load, making data extraction faster and more reliable for AI agents.

items.title: Artificial-Analysis/llm-value-rankings
items.snippet: This repository provides daily LLM value rankings, comparing over 300 models by intelligence, speed, and price, utilizing data from OpenRouter and Artificial Analysis. The leaderboard offers live rankings of open-weight LLMs by benchmark scores, including context length and pricing. It aims to help users identify the best value AI models of the day based on AI value per dollar from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, speed, and OpenRouter pricing.

items.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
items.snippet: This paper introduces speculative sampling for interactive video generation, aiming to accelerate the inference process while maintaining high-quality outputs. The method allows for faster response times in real-time video synthesis applications. It contributes to improving the efficiency of generative models in interactive settings.

items.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
items.snippet: Scene-Designer explores learning design intelligence to enable agentic 3D scene generation, allowing AI agents to create complex and coherent 3D environments autonomously. This work advances the field of embodied AI and agent-based design. It focuses on developing systems that can understand and apply design principles in 3D space.

items.title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
items.snippet: BridgeWAM introduces a novel approach to bridge video and action experts through latent bridge queries, improving the integration of visual information with actionable intelligence in AI systems. This method aims to enhance the understanding and execution capabilities of agents in complex visual environments. It contributes to more cohesive multimodal AI systems.
related_to: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models

items.title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
items.snippet: This paper proposes a method for evaluating AI agents by their ability to conduct evidence-supported physics research, moving from initial research goals to scientific closure. It provides a framework for assessing agent performance in complex scientific reasoning tasks. The work is significant for developing more autonomous and effective scientific discovery agents.

items.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.snippet: This research introduces tree-aware posterior distillation for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning, enhancing the ability of agents to plan and execute complex tasks over extended periods. The method improves the learning efficiency and decision-making capabilities of agents in scenarios requiring foresight. It's a step towards more capable and autonomous AI agents.
